name: Orange Enzymes Exfoliating Brightening Gel LF16-35 | Gentle Face Scrub for Glowing Skin
description:
Experience smooth, glowing, and refreshed skin with the Orange Enzymes Exfoliating Brightening Gel LF16-35 — a gentle yet powerful exfoliating gel designed to remove dead skin cells, unclog pores, and brighten your complexion.Formulated with natural orange enzymes, French exfoliating acids (Lactic & Citric Acid), and 7 brightening ingredients including Niacinamide and Vitamin C, this gel helps reveal softer, more luminous skin without irritation. The light, non-sticky texture makes it ideal for all skin types — even sensitive skin.Key Features:
 Gentle exfoliation removes dead skin cells & impurities
 Brightens dull skin and evens out tone
 Hydrates and softens skin after use
 Enriched with Vitamin C, Niacinamide & natural orange extracts
 Suitable for all skin types (men & women)
 Lightweight, non-irritating gel texture

How to Use:
1⃣ Make sure your face and hands are dry before application.
2⃣ Apply a generous amount of gel to the desired area.
3⃣ Massage gently in circular motions until dead skin cells peel off.
4⃣ Rinse thoroughly with clean water.
5⃣ Use 2–3 times a week for best results.
